data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Certificazioni Linguistiche (Cambridge/DELF), Viaggi Studio all'estero, Debate Club, Teatro Classico
data.PCTO_Network_Quality: Partnerships with Universities, Elite cultural institutions
data.Inequality_Mechanism: High cultural capital acceleration. PTOF reinforces existing elite status.

data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Corsi di recupero, Teatro, Giornalino Scolastico
data.Inequality_Mechanism: Strong baseline, but lacks the internationalization of Northern PTOFs.

data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Robotica, Coding (Python/C++), Certificazioni CISCO, Olimpiadi della Matematica
data.Inequality_Mechanism: Directly accelerates STEM employability and university admission.

data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Simulazione d'Impresa, Certificazioni Informatiche (ECDL/EIPASS), PCTO in Banche
data.Inequality_Mechanism: Strong alignment with local labor market needs.

data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Laboratori base, PCTO virtuale o interno alla scuola
data.Inequality_Mechanism: PTOF struggles to bridge the gap due to lack of local industrial partners for PCTO.

data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Acquisto materie prime per cucine, Corsi HACCP base, Corsi di recupero dispersione
data.Inequality_Mechanism: PTOF is heavily focused on basic material provision and remedial education to prevent dropout.

data.Typical_PTOF_Offerings: Recupero competenze di base (Italian/Math), Sportelli d'ascolto psicologico
data.Inequality_Mechanism: PTOF acts as a social welfare net rather than an academic accelerator. Voluntary contributions are near zero.
